## Verdict: FAIL (one clause of line 1)

Line 4 is fixed (CONFIRMED). Line 1 is fixed in substance on every lawful network this seat measured (CONFIRMED), with
two recorded deviations it accepts (below). One clause of line 1's required change is implemented but **not pinned by
any test**: "where neither works, refuse E_INVARIANT (fail-safe)". Mutant N13 — the pinned-first fallback accepting the
placement wherever it lands, i.e. round S3's far pin moved into the fallback — survives every test of the item, and
it is not equivalent: through the item's own `pinFirst` seam on four lawful B-FUZZ networks the tree refuses
E_INVARIANT while N13 commits pins 96 – 324 cm off their contacts (table below). By the brief's mutation rule (a
survivor on a stated promise that the checker does not find equivalent stays a blocker) this one clause fails. The
required change is one test.

The gates are green: install, lint, build, landed:verify, NEAR at the PR size (13 files, 65/65). RELATED at 1000 has one red, which is not the item's
(identical with the pre-round engine; another seat's in-flight file).
